status: Unreleased source reference; not a published 0.8.3 artifact
distribution: Vue peer range ^3.3.0. Install from npm; import components from littlebrand-ui-kit and CSS from littlebrand-ui-kit/style.css. This source reference describes unreleased develop work, not the published 0.8.3 artifact. Deep imports are unsupported.

components.name: LbButton
components.purpose: Trigger an action or navigate to a destination.
components.use: Use a native button for actions; inside a form use type=submit with one form @submit.prevent handler. Use href for a URL, or to only in a host with Vue Router.
components.avoid: Do not attach the same action to both a submit button click and its form submit; do not use iconOnly without an accessible name or a link for a disabled action.
components.accessibility: Native button by default; iconOnly needs aria-label. Loading exposes aria-busy and blocks activation. Disabled/loading links become disabled buttons.
states: filled, tonal, outline, ghost or link
dependencies: Vue Router only for the to prop

components.name: LbInput
components.purpose: Collect one line of text with v-model.
components.use: Use a visible label or aria-label; pass native name and autocomplete when submitting forms.
components.avoid: Do not request small size or assume v-model emits numbers: updates are strings.
components.accessibility: Invalid sets aria-invalid; loading disables the native input. Clear and password controls are unavailable while disabled or readonly.
components.usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import 'littlebrand-ui-kit/style.css'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LbInput } from 'littlebrand-ui-kit'
const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <label for="contact-email">Email</label>
  <LbInput id="contact-email" v-model="email" type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required />
</template>

components.name: LbTextarea
components.purpose: Collect longer free-form text with v-model.
components.use: Associate a visible label or aria-label. For a standalone textarea, pass native name and aria-describedby for helper text; when nested in FormField, it supplies the control id and message description.
components.avoid: Do not assume FormField supplies validation or a required native attribute; explicitly set invalid/required on the control. No small size exists.
components.accessibility: Uses a native textarea. Invalid sets aria-invalid; readonly and disabled preserve native semantics. The outline and ring stay visible on keyboard focus in both themes.

components.name: LbFormField
components.purpose: Compose a label, control and one helper or validation message.
components.use: Nest an Input or Textarea, supply label and hint/error, and bind v-model on the control. Pass required and invalid to the control itself. For submission, handle the native form @submit.prevent once and use LbButton type=submit.
components.avoid: Do not expect FormField to validate or set aria-invalid/required on its child. Do not also call the submit handler on button click. If using labelFor, keep it matched to the actual control ID.
components.accessibility: Provides a stable generated id and aria-describedby for injected Input/Textarea; the visible label targets that id and the message supplies its description. A label alone does not mark the control required.
states: error, warning or success message (in that priority)
dependencies: LbLabel and LbHintText internally (standalone APIs not verified in this slice)
components.usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import 'littlebrand-ui-kit/style.css'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LbFormField, LbTextarea, LbButton } from 'littlebrand-ui-kit'
const biography = ref('')
const error = ref('')
const emit = defineEmits<{ save: [biography: string] }>()
function onSubmit() {
  const text = biography.value.trim()
  error.value = text ? '' : 'Biography is required'
  if (!error.value) emit('save', text)
}
</script>

<template>
  <form novalidate @submit.prevent="onSubmit">
    <LbFormField label="Biography" hint="Tell us a little about yourself." :error="error" required>
      <LbTextarea v-model="biography" name="biography" :invalid="Boolean(error)" required />
    </LbFormField>
    <LbButton type="submit">Save biography</LbButton>
  </form>
</template>

components.name: LbDialog
components.purpose: Present a modal decision or focused content.
components.use: Bind v-model and give the dialog a title or an ARIA name; use the footer slot for actions. For a reusable wrapper supporting Vue 3.3, declare modelValue and emit update:modelValue (a computed getter/setter can bridge to v-model).
components.avoid: Do not use defineModel in a Vue 3.3-compatible wrapper: that macro requires Vue 3.4+. Do not use variant=filled; only default and fullscreen exist. The header slot renders only in fullscreen and needs its own visible heading.
components.accessibility: Teleports to body with originating theme; focuses dialog on open, contains Tab and restores trigger focus on close. Escape/backdrop respect close props.

components.name: LbSegmentButton
components.purpose: Choose one or more options from a short set of segments.
components.use: Nest LbSegmentButtonItem inside the root; bind v-model and label the group. For a reusable wrapper supporting Vue 3.3, declare modelValue and emit update:modelValue (a computed getter/setter can bridge to v-model).
components.avoid: Do not use defineModel in a Vue 3.3-compatible wrapper: that macro requires Vue 3.4+. Never mount LbSegmentButtonItem alone; it requires root context. Do not treat optional toggle mode as mandatory radio mode.
components.accessibility: Optional selection uses toggle buttons; nonempty mandatory single selection uses radio semantics. Arrow/Home/End skip disabled items; label icon-only items.
components.usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import 'littlebrand-ui-kit/style.css'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LbSegmentButton, LbSegmentButtonItem } from 'littlebrand-ui-kit'
const choice = ref<string | number>('daily')
</script>

<template>
  <LbSegmentButton v-model="choice" :allow-empty="false" aria-label="Frequency">
    <LbSegmentButtonItem value="daily">Daily</LbSegmentButtonItem>
    <LbSegmentButtonItem value="weekly">Weekly</LbSegmentButtonItem>
  </LbSegmentButton>
</template>

components.name: LbSegmentButtonItem
components.use: Provide a unique value and visible text or ariaLabel within a labelled root.
components.avoid: Never use independently; it throws without its parent context.
components.accessibility: Renders a button, with aria-pressed in optional/multi mode or radio semantics in mandatory single mode.
components.usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import 'littlebrand-ui-kit/style.css'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { LbSegmentButton, LbSegmentButtonItem } from 'littlebrand-ui-kit'
const choice = ref<string | number>('daily')
</script>

<template>
  <LbSegmentButton v-model="choice" :allow-empty="false" aria-label="Frequency">
    <LbSegmentButtonItem value="daily">Daily</LbSegmentButtonItem>
    <LbSegmentButtonItem value="weekly">Weekly</LbSegmentButtonItem>
  </LbSegmentButton>
</template>

tokens.purpose: Primary solid control fill; light/dark palette step 9.

tokens.name: --lb-text-on-primary
tokens.purpose: Readable foreground on primary normal fill; contrast anchor chosen per mode/state, not ordinary primary text.

tokens.name: --lb-focus-ring-color
tokens.purpose: Button focus ring color, resolved from the primary focus border role; width and offset use shared SASS sizing.

tokens.name: --lb-text-neutral-normal
tokens.purpose: Normal neutral reading text, palette step 11.

tokens.name: --lb-surface-subtle
tokens.purpose: Global background-source subtle layer used by the Dialog panel, separate from family-specific surfaces.

tokens.name: --lb-surface-overlay
tokens.purpose: Dialog backdrop overlay, not a tinted surface step.

tokens.name: --lb-surface-primary-active
tokens.purpose: Primary tinted selected/pressed surface, palette step 5; not keyboard focus.
